pr95.title: Add fail-closed daily sports operations preflight
pr95.head: 5acf5972bc448b4e5c03b65ee69ecd38033765c0
pr95.body:
## Summary
- Adds a scheduled/manual daily source-capture and repository-health preflight.
- Preserves capture and healthcheck evidence as a run artifact even when a check fails.
- Fails closed when acquisition receipts are incomplete or repository health checks fail.
- Documents the end-to-end acceptance requirements for pregame cards, end-of-day reviews, provenance, qualification, and delivery.

## Important scope boundary
This is an operations guardrail, **not** the completed autonomous card pipeline. It does not yet invoke all model-specific forecast builders, register pregame forecasts, generate all league cards, or confirm external notification/delivery. The repository currently lacks verified evidence that those steps are wired end-to-end. The workflow explicitly does not authorize wagering or label source capture as a forecast.

## Validation status
- Source files read back from the feature branch after commit.
- Hosted workflow execution and Python tests have not yet been run from this session.
- Do not merge or treat as production-ready until the workflow run is inspected and its capture/healthcheck behavior is verified.

pr100.title: Add opt-in event freshness for CFB personnel-v2 research
pr100.head: 86f30e08fcdedeea022c28a621d3dea48fd7a6c1
pr100.body:
CFB personnel-v2 currently excludes later-week pre-kickoff updates at its weekly cutoff. This adds an explicit event-refresh inference child of the frozen weekly personnel-v2 fit, using min(requested as-of, kickoff minus the declared buffer) for personnel only. Existing weekly features, training-label checks, selected defaults and original forecasts stay unchanged.

The new CLI route reuses existing source/value/cutoff validation, checks exact event identity and linked source revisions, requires independently signed pre-cutoff snapshots for historical admission, and retains append-only refresh receipts with raw personnel bytes. No clock authority is enabled. Live unanchored captures remain diagnostic; source authenticity, parent PIT and predictive qualification are separate requirements. No automatic promotion, canonical registration or wagering authority.

Validation:
- 1,034 scoped tests passed, including 32 new freshness tests. Six initial WNBA dependency failures disappeared after installing the repository-pinned pyarrow and rerunning the identical suite.
- Tests exercise late quarterback updates, missing timestamps, cutoff equality, conflicting revisions, untrusted/modified signatures, post-start requests and writer completion, duplicate identities, immutable receipts, retained-byte verification after original paths disappear, baseline preservation and market independence.
- Two synthetic refresh versions retained for one fixture event; these are engineering evidence only.
- 1,565 protected files hash-match PR #99.
- 47 retained October 31 CFB captures hash-match; zero supply admissible personnel-v2 inputs. Authentic qualifying predictive events: zero.
- Repository health remains RED: four existing failures and seven warnings.

[Policy and integration points](https://github.com/georgemunoz1-ui/sports-model/blob/codex/cfb-personnel-event-freshness-20261031/docs/research/cfb_personnel_freshness_20261031/README.md)
[Execution evidence](https://github.com/georgemunoz1-ui/sports-model/blob/codex/cfb-personnel-event-freshness-20261031/docs/research/cfb_personnel_freshness_20261031/EXECUTION.json)

Stacked on draft PR #99 at eb70c0c. Historical acceptance packets remain unchanged; the CI finding check uses a version-bound successor after re-executing their scope. A dedicated workflow tests this stacked PR. Draft only; not merged or activated.

issue96.title: Unblock end-to-end daily card generation, registration, review, and delivery
issue96.body:
## Incident
October 25 end-of-day review and October 26 pregame card delivery were not proven end-to-end. The repository has a scheduled canonical grading workflow, but its latest inspected run (39999394059) reports successful workflow execution while the canonical registry has zero prospective registrations. The diagnostic shadow-card workflow is manual/repository-dispatch/legacy-branch driven and requires an existing source-bound package artifact for most leagues. Current runtime documentation explicitly says an autonomous daily seven-league card pipeline and verified durable archive/notification are not established.

## Required acceptance criteria
- [ ] Restore a reproducible, pinned execution environment for every model-specific current runner.
- [ ] Reconcile operational capture outputs (events.json, report.json, manifest.json) with the acquisition.json bundle contract without weakening source hashes, timestamps, or coverage gates.
- [ ] Fix qualification evidence value/type validation and rerun clean-interpreter regression tests; resolve any stale-bytecode discrepancy.
- [ ] Implement a single scheduled orchestration path that runs acquisition, per-league forecast builders, pre-start cutoff checks, full-slate receipts, selector registration, immutable card publication, and durable artifact readback.
- [ ] Implement a separate end-of-day path that grades only registered immutable forecasts against authenticated settlement sources and produces a review with exclusions/missingness.
- [ ] Add explicit failure notifications and delivery receipts; a missing card/review or failed upload must alert rather than silently pass.
- [ ] Recover October 25 only from authentic saved pregame forecasts and verified results; do not retro-register or relabel reconstructions as pregame.
- [ ] Generate October 26 only as research-only reconstruction unless an authentic pre-start forecast receipt is found.
- [ ] Demonstrate two successful forward runs, one injected-failure alert, artifact readback, and independent audit before marking operational.
- [ ] Keep official release and wagering authority OFF until existing qualification gates independently pass.

## Evidence references
- [Daily operations acceptance standard PR #95](https://github.com/georgemunoz1-ui/sports-model/pull/95)
- [Current runtime boundaries](https://github.com/georgemunoz1-ui/sports-model/blob/main/docs/ALL_MODELS_CURRENT_RUNTIME.md)
- [Current refresh contract](https://github.com/georgemunoz1-ui/sports-model/blob/main/docs/CURRENT_SPORTS_DATA.md)
- [Canonical grading workflow](https://github.com/georgemunoz1-ui/sports-model/blob/main/.github/workflows/canonical-research-grading.yml)
- [Diagnostic shadow-card workflow](https://github.com/georgemunoz1-ui/sports-model/blob/main/.github/workflows/diagnostic-shadow-card.yml)

## Safety
Do not merge a workflow change without running and reviewing it. Do not change selected models, original forecasts, selector rules, or action authority as a workaround for missing evidence. A green software check is not forecast qualification.
